title: Besan Chilla
description: A savoury, protein-rich gram-flour pancake spiced with onion, chilli and coriander — a quick vegetarian breakfast, ready in under 20 minutes.
steps: In a bowl, whisk the besan with water gradually to form a smooth, lump-free batter of medium-thin, pourable consistency.
Stir in the onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander leaves, turmeric, red chilli powder, carom seeds and salt. Mix well.
Heat a lightly oiled non-stick tawa or griddle over medium heat. Pour a ladleful of batter and spread into a thin circle, about 6 inches across.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook for 2-3 minutes until the base turns golden and the top looks set.
Flip carefully and cook the other side for another 2 minutes until golden.
Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve hot with green chutney or tomato ketchup.
